home-is-hard.name: Run-down home
home-is-hard.line: My home is cramped, falling apart or too noisy.
home-is-hard.why: Names the problem the way Homeless and Eviction do, so the Home heading stops mixing problem and area labels, and keeps the three everyday things people actually complain about.

home-is-hard.name: Bad housing
home-is-hard.line: The place I live is in bad shape, and I can't fix it or move.
home-is-hard.why: Says what makes it a pain rather than a list of faults: the place is bad and the person is stuck with it.

cold-home.name: Cold home
cold-home.line: I can't afford to keep my home warm.
cold-home.why: A problem name that matches the heading, and 'keep my home warm' is how people say it; it also sets this apart from being behind on the power bill.

cold-home.name: Cold or hot
cold-home.line: I can't afford to keep my home warm in winter or cool in summer.
cold-home.why: Echoes the earlier name Cold or hot home and covers summer heat, which hits many people as hard as winter cold.

unsafe-near-me.name: Unsafe area
unsafe-near-me.line: I don't feel safe in my neighborhood.
unsafe-near-me.why: Says where the danger is, so nobody mixes it up with Safety at home on the People page, and the name becomes a problem like the rest of the heading.

getting-around.name: Can't get around
getting-around.line: I can't easily get to work, the store or the doctor.
getting-around.why: Names the places people actually miss, which makes the line concrete, and turns the name into a problem like the rest of the heading.

offline.name: Bad internet
offline.line: I can't get internet that's fast enough and that I can afford.
offline.why: Keeps the earlier wording's two causes, speed and price, and makes the name a problem so it fits the heading if it is ever shown.
